fullDescription: A professional YouTube channel banner system designed with a Gothic Final Fantasy aesthetic. This high-contrast design features a 'Fire and Ice' color palette (#ff4d00 and #00d2ff) against a dark, moody medieval background. Optimized for gaming channels, lore analysis, and fantasy-themed content creators, the layout strictly adheres to YouTube's safe-zone requirements (2560x1440px total area with a 1546x423px central safe zone). Key elements include cinematic typography using Cinzel and Crimson Pro, glassmorphism UI components, and ambient shimmer animations.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dark, cinematic YouTube banner inspired by gothic fantasy epics, featuring dramatic title typography, dual-tone lighting (warm orange vs. cool cyan), and dedicated UI areas for profile pictures and social calls-to-action.

## Estilo Visual
Create a visual style with a base background color of #0a0a0c. Implement a 'Fire' accent using #ff4d00 with a text-shadow of 0 0 10px rgba(255, 77, 0, 0.8). Implement an 'Ice' accent using #00d2ff with a text-shadow of 0 0 15px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.8). Typography: Use 'Cinzel' (weights 400, 700, 900) for primary titles in uppercase; use 'Crimson Pro' (weights 300, 600) in italics for body text and descriptors. Layout effects must include a radial vignette (transparent center to 90% black edges) and a subtle horizontal shimmer animation (linear, 5s duration, using a 90-degree gradient from transparent to 5% white). Include glassmorphism elements with background-blur: 12px and border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Background Layer
Full 2560x1440px coverage. Use a grayscale-filtered fantasy landscape (castles, dragons) with 60% opacity and 1.2 contrast. Layer a radial vignette on top to focus light on the center. Add a thin 1px horizontal gradient line at the very top and bottom of the visible banner area (roughly 423px height from the vertical center).

### Branding Centerpiece
Centered vertically and horizontally. Start with a sub-heading: 'Cinzel' font, 12px, 0.4em letter-spacing, color #fb923c, flanked by two 48px horizontal lines. Below, the main title: 'GOTHIC' in Cinzel 72px bold with orange glow. Under 'GOTHIC', place a 2px horizontal line with a cyan glow (0 0 15px #00d2ff). Below the line, 'FINAL FANTASY' in Crimson Pro 36px, light weight, italicized, with a cyan glow.

### Left Profile Area
Positioned 16px from the left edge of the safe zone. A 180x180px circular placeholder with a 2px white/10 border. This area must remain empty of critical text to allow for the YouTube profile picture cutout. Include a subtle user icon (opacity 20%) as a placeholder.

### Right CTA and Socials
Positioned at the right edge of the safe zone. A glassmorphism card (white/5 background, 10% white border, backdrop-blur) containing social icons (YouTube, Twitter, Discord) in white/60. Include a 'Weekly Uploads' indicator in Cinzel 10px. Below the card, add a pulsing 'SUBSCRIBE' prompt with a bell icon in #ff4d00.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Dual-Element Divider — A horizontal separator that transitions the theme from fire to ice.
A 2px high horizontal line spanning 80% of the title width. Use a linear gradient: transparent, via cyan-400 (#22d3ee), to transparent. Add a box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.8) to simulate a glowing energy blade effect.

### Lore Tags — Small icons with labels for channel categories.
A row of items consisting of an icon (sword, dragon, scroll) in alternating fire/ice colors, followed by 14px Crimson Pro italicized text. Separate items with a 6px circular dot in 20% white.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Keep all critical text and branding within the central 1546px wide safe zone. MUST: Use high-contrast between the fire-orange and ice-blue elements to create visual tension. MUST NOT: Use bright background imagery; the background must stay dark (#0a0a0c) to ensure legibility. MUST: Use Cinzel for all 'Epic' headers and Crimson Pro for all 'Narrative' descriptions.
